caption: An intimate instrumental for turning the pages of a Korean neighborhood counseling photo album. Warm close-miked felt piano introduces a small rising three-note idea, answered by fingerpicked nylon guitar; gently changing voicings like afternoon sunlight across paper. A steady lilting 6/8 at 72 BPM, D major, touching and quietly optimistic. Restrained dynamics for reading, space between phrases, a delicate returning cadence. Purely acoustic instrumental, no vocals, no humming, no drums.
